Carve-out applies: the referent is the artefact the student's own module-arc just produced, not a missing slide. Rest of the sequential pass, re-checked against the raw body: 'The check' (line 7, second sentence) resolves against 'a gate'/'the gate' from line 6; 'these' (line 8) resolves against the three countermoves named two clauses earlier in the same bullet; 'The three countermoves' (line 9) is a same-bullet repeat of line 8's list, not a forward or vague pointer; 'this loop' (line 15) is anaphoric to the compare-and-teach move described in the same bullet's first two sentences (not cataphoric -- the process is named before 'this loop', not after); 'this'/'tampering' (line 34) IS cataphoric, resolved by the colon immediately following in the same sentence ('called this tampering: chasing ordinary variance...'); 'the model'/'the gates' (line 45) and 'your gates and workflow' (line 47) continue vocabulary named on lines 6-23 (gate, judge) and the frontier slide's own opening bullet (the model, line 43-44 implicitly via 'checks you have verified').
